T: New steps on the dance floor. Old favourites on the plate.
D: A champion ballroom dancer risks everything by dancing his own steps with a beginner.
P: Serve the mains when Fran's dad shows Scott the real paso doble.
S: Blinis with smoked salmon and crème fraîche, cucumber cups with whipped goat's cheese
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and cucumber cups filled with whipped goat's cheese and chives, laid on silver trays.
Slow cooked potato and onion folded into eggs, cut into squares
Potatoes and onion sliced thin and cooked slowly in plenty of olive oil for 25 minutes, drained, folded into beaten eggs, cooked in a pan, flipped and cut into squares.
Rico shows Scott the real paso doble out the back

Crisp roast potato cubes under a smoky, spicy tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, finished with paprika and parsley. Cut 1kg potatoes into 3cm cubes and boil 5 minutes. Drain, toss in 60ml olive oil and salt and roast at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Cook 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp cayenne and 400g crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes, then blend. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove. Top the potatoes with both sauces and parsley.
M: Chicken and chorizo paella with saffron rice and prawns

Chicken thighs and chorizo browned in a wide pan, onion, garlic, capsicum and paprika, Calasparra rice and saffron stock, cooked without stirring for 20 minutes, prawns pushed in for the last 5. Brown 600g chicken thigh pieces and 150g sliced chorizo in a wide pan. Add an onion, 2 garlic cloves, a red capsicum and 1 tsp paprika. Stir in 300g paella rice and 1L hot stock with saffron and cook without stirring for 20 minutes. Push in 300g prawns for the last 5.
the Federation's safe choice, Barry Fife presiding

Butter-basted chicken breasts with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, crunchy roast potatoes and steamed broccolini, a proper dinner dance plate. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, toss in oil and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil 4 minutes a side, add 30g butter and thyme and baste, then finish at 200C for 10 minutes. Rest. In the same pan cook 250g sliced mushrooms and 1 shallot, add 125ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam 2 bunches broccolini.
W: Fried cinnamon sugar churros with a hot chocolate dip
Choux dough of water, butter and flour piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, tossed in cinnamon sugar, with thick hot chocolate for dipping.
K: Red wine sangria with brandy, orange juice and fruit, topped with soda

Red wine, brandy, orange juice and sliced orange, lemon and apple in a jug, chilled 2 hours, topped with soda. Mix a 750ml bottle of red wine, 60ml brandy and 250ml orange juice in a jug with a sliced orange, lemon and apple. Chill 2 hours, then top with 300ml soda water and pour over ice.

steps.text: Slice the potatoes and onion thin.
Cook slowly in the olive oil until soft but not coloured.
Drain, then fold into the beaten eggs and season.
Cook in a pan over low heat until nearly set, flip with a plate and cook the other side. Cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the chorizo and chop the onion and capsicum up to 1 day ahead; cook the paella on the night

steps.text: Slice the chorizo, dice the onion and capsicum, and crush the garlic. Heat the stock with the saffron.
Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan.
Add the onion, garlic, capsicum and paprika and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice and hot stock, then cook without stirring.
Push the prawns into the rice for the last 5 minutes, then rest briefly before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the onion and capsicum and trim the beans up to 1 day ahead; cook the paella on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion and capsicum, crush the garlic and trim the beans. Heat the stock with the saffron.
Fry the chickpeas and mushrooms in the oil with 1 tsp of the paprika in a wide pan until crisp at the edges.
Add the onion, garlic, capsicum and the rest of the paprika and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice and hot stock, then cook without stirring.
Push the artichoke hearts and beans into the rice for the last 5 minutes, then rest briefly and serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Dough up to 2 hours ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Boil the water with the butter, beat in the flour until a smooth dough forms, then beat in the eggs.
Pipe strips into oil heated to 180C and fry in batches until golden.
Toss the churros in the sugar and cinnamon.
Melt the chocolate into the hot milk for dipping.

s.note: Blinis with smoked salmon and crème fraîche, cucumber cups with whipped goat's cheese
s.how: Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and dill. Cut a cucumber into thick rounds, scoop a hollow and fill with 100g goat's cheese whipped smooth. Lay them on silver trays.

s.note: Slow cooked potato and onion folded into eggs, cut into squares
s.how: Slice 600g potatoes and an onion thin and cook slowly in 250ml olive oil for 25 minutes. Drain, fold into 6 beaten eggs and season. Cook in a pan over low heat, flip with a plate and cook the other side. Cut into squares.

m.note: Chicken and chorizo paella with saffron rice and prawns
m.how: Brown 600g chicken thigh pieces and 150g sliced chorizo in a wide pan. Add an onion, 2 garlic cloves, a red capsicum and 1 tsp paprika. Stir in 300g paella rice and 1L hot stock with saffron and cook without stirring for 20 minutes. Push in 300g prawns for the last 5.

w.note: Fried cinnamon sugar churros with a hot chocolate dip
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 60g butter, beat in 150g flour, then 2 eggs. Pipe into 180C oil and fry until golden. Toss in 100g sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 300ml hot milk for dipping.
